test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 01 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Select the option with the correct use of present tense.

options.text: She has spend all her money on make-up in order to look beautiful.
She spended all her money on make-up in order to look beautiful.
She had spend all her money on make-up in order to look beautiful.
She spends all her money on make-up in order to look beautiful.

solution: The correct answer is '4' i.e. This sentence correctly uses the present tense.
